details.effect: [fanfare] Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 2 damage. Spellchain (5): Deal 4 damage instead. SC (10): Deal 2 damage to that follower's leader.

options.label: Deal 2 damage to an enemy follower
Deal 4 damage to an enemy follower
Deal 2 damage to that follower's leader

issues: The fanfare effect is encoded as a choose between three options, but the source is not optional; it should be a single effect that deals 2 damage to a selected enemy follower, deals 4 instead if Spellchain (5), and additionally deals 2 damage to that follower's leader if Spellchain (10).
The Spellchain (5) condition is missing; encode the damage amount as conditional on condition {"type":"spellchain","count":5} rather than as a separate choice.

The SC (10) bonus damage to that follower's leader is incorrectly encoded as an independent option; it should be an additional conditional effect tied to the same selected follower, not a standalone choice targeting any enemy leader.

details.effect: [fanfare] Summon a Naterran Great Tree token. If Overflow is active for you, summon up to 2 instead and give this follower Rush.

options.label: Summon a Naterran Great Tree token
If Overflow is active for you, summon up to 2 instead and give this follower Rush

issues: The fanfare is incorrectly encoded as a choose effect; it should always summon 1 Naterran Great Tree, with an Overflow conditional replacing that with up to 2 and granting this follower Rush.
The base summon and Overflow-enhanced summon are not mutually chosen by the player; encode as a single sequence/conditional fanfare rather than two options.

The source says "summon up to 2 instead," but the parsed effect forces exactly 2 under Overflow; it should allow summoning 1 or 2 if the engine supports optional count, otherwise this should be represented as closely as possible without using choose.

details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this. [fanfare] Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 2 damage. [act] Earth Rite: Give this Assail.

The activated Earth Rite ability should not include a meaningless pp cost of 0; remove the pp cost and encode only the Earth Rite cost.
